question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Coward And The Sword’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jugal Hansraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Kingdom of Kofu **is ruled by the **brave king Rissho.**
 
• Its people are **courageous **and **skilled in war **with one exception. 
 
• **Prince Kadis**, the **sixteen-year-old **heir to the **kingdom. **He is not brave. He is not **courageous. **He is **not skilled in war**. **Kadis **knows in his heart that he does not fit in. That he is **different**. That he is **a coward**. Until one day, **a seemingly chance **encounter **changes **his life completely. Armed with the **mystical sword of Kofu**, the timid prince and his two young friends, **embark **on an **epic trip to bring peace **to the **warring kingdoms **of Kofu and Milonga. Will the young prince overcome his fears and will peace win against war?
 
• **Jugal Hansraj** is an **Indian actor, model, producer, writer, author **and **director**, based in **New York**. Hansraj started his career as a child **actor **in the **1983 film Masoom**, which starred **Naseeruddin Shah **and **Shabana Azmi**. He continued his career as a **child actor in films like Karma and Sultanat**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rushad Rana**__ is an Indian actor and influencer.
 
• He is well known for his portrayal of Raghav in Hip Hip Hurray, Nikhil in Kehta Hai Dil, Sumit in Sasural Simar Ka, Coach Sir in Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai and Aniruddh Gandhi in Anupamaa.
 
• **__Jimmy Sheirgill__ **also credited as Jimmy Shergill, is an Indian actor and film producer who works in Hindi and Punjabi films.
 
• Sheirgill began his film career with the 1996 thriller Maachis.
 
• __**Uday Raj Chopra**__ is an Indian actor, film producer, director, screenwriter and assistant director in Bollywood.
 
• He is the son of the late filmmaker Yash Chopra and brother of Aditya Chopra.
